## spaceman telegram bot delete

Remove the bot's configuration (Telegram off; links stay).

```sh
spaceman telegram bot delete [flags]
```

API: `get-telegram-bot`, `delete-telegram-bot` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
| `--yes` | bool |  | confirm: remove the Telegram bot's configuration |

## spaceman telegram bot set

Configure the bot or change its configuration (only the flags given change).

A new token is checked with Telegram (getMe) before it is stored; it comes from a file or standard input and is never shown again. Configuring a different bot revokes every Telegram link. Needs system:write and a step-up.

```sh
spaceman telegram bot set [flags]
```

API: `get-telegram-bot`, `put-telegram-bot` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman telegram bot set --bot-token-file ~/.tg/token --enabled --mode polling
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--bot-token-file` | string |  | bot token from BotFather; required when configuring, omit to keep the stored one (read from this file; never pass secrets as flag values) |
| `--bot-token-stdin` | bool |  | read --bot-token-file's value from standard input instead |
| `--enabled` | bool |  | run the bot |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--if-match` | string |  | expected object version (from an earlier read); default: the version read just before the change |
| `--miniapp-host` | string |  | the Mini App's own host, e.g. tg.central.example.com (empty: Mini App off) |
| `--mode` | string |  | webhook (default; needs an https public_url) or polling |
| `--webhook-ip-allowlist` | string, repeatable |  | CIDR the webhook accepts requests from, e.g. 149.154.160.0/20 (empty: no check) (repeatable or comma-separated) |
